If exhaustive history is required, this CLI-only proposal does not establish it and a separately reviewed observation mechanism would be a new requirement.

Expected RED child exits1 are kept as raw results and only the completed, independently accepted RED package can advance producer authorship. No primary success transfers to a rejected package.
acceptance.attempts: One selected attempt per RED or GREEN package. Failed preflight, unexpected result, interruption, unknown launch, incomplete output/cleanup/postflight or missing outer observation spends the attempt. No rerun, partial resume, acceptance by aggregate count, hidden retry or auto-rescue is allowed.
